1. Enterprise SA Selection Decision Tree (R591)
18-Client MCP Eval, 6-Engine Semantic Layer, Local AirClaw & Mobile QA
Q1: Test & Eval MCP Servers Across 18 Clients & 170+ Models?
• MCPJam/inspector (★2331, @mcpjam/inspector, TypeScript):
Tests MCP tools, prompts, resources, OAuth & ChatGPT apps
Simulates 18 client configs across 170+ LLMs with CI evals
• Catches tool-schema & auth regressions before shipping
Q2: Agent-Authored Semantic Layers (57% data-eng-bench)?
• exmergo/dex (★139, Apache-2.0, Python PyPI):
Authors & syncs dbt, SLayer, Cube, Apache Ossie,
Snowflake Semantic Views & Databricks Metric Views
• Keeps semantic definitions synchronized as DB schemas evolve
Q3: Zero-Cost Local Gateway (:4096) for OpenClaw + AirLLM?
• nickzsche21/AirClaw (★120, MIT, Python):
Unified :4096 endpoint over Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio
Includes AirLLM layer-wise execution for oversized models
• airclaw detect / start / patch / doctor lifecycle commands
Q4: Zero-Telemetry Android & iOS Mobile Automation Agent?
• appclawhq/AppClaw (★120, Apache-2.0, TypeScript):
Plain-English mobile automation via appium-mcp
LLM-agnostic (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Groq, local Ollama)
• Zero telemetry + appclaw doctor preflight check
2. End-to-End Enterprise MCP Evaluation, Semantic Layer Sync & Local/Mobile Agent Architecture
Four-Pillar Stack: MCPJam 18-Client Eval ➔ Exmergo Dex 6-Target Semantic Layer ➔ AirClaw :4096 Gateway ➔ AppClaw Mobile
Pillar A: MCP Eval Platform (MCPJam/inspector)
• Cross-Client Matrix: Tests MCP servers, MCP apps & ChatGPT
apps across 18 client configurations & 170+ models
• Full Protocol Coverage: Interactive debugging of tools,
prompts, resources, OAuth flows & error payloads
• Automated CI Evals: Runs test suites to pinpoint tool-call
regressions when descriptions or schemas change
• Distribution: `@mcpjam/inspector` on npm
✓ Eliminates "works in Claude Desktop, breaks in Cursor" bugs
Pillar B: Agentic Semantic Layer Builder (exmergo/dex)
• Benchmark Verified: 57% score on data-eng-bench
• 6 Semantic Layer Targets: Authors & maintains dbt, SLayer,
Cube, Apache Ossie, Snowflake Semantic Views &
Databricks Metric Views from warehouse metadata
• Drift Prevention: Continuously synchronizes semantic metrics
as underlying lakehouse/warehouse schemas evolve
• Package: `pip install exmergo-dex-core` (Apache-2.0)
✓ Unifies Snowflake, Databricks & dbt semantic layer authoring
Pillar C: Local OpenClaw Endpoint (nickzsche21/AirClaw)
• Stable `:4096` Gateway: Decouples OpenClaw agent config
from underlying local inference servers
• 5 Local Backends: Hot-swaps Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM,
LM Studio & AirLLM (runs models larger than GPU VRAM)
• 4-Command Workflow: `airclaw detect` -> `airclaw start` ->
`airclaw patch` -> `airclaw doctor` (3-link chain check)
• Version Note: Install 3.0.0+ from Git/releases (MIT)
✓ Cuts OpenClaw daemon API spend to $0 on local workstations
Pillar D: Mobile Automation Agent (appclawhq/AppClaw)
• Cross-Platform Mobile QA: Drives Android & iOS physical
devices, emulators & simulators via `appium-mcp`
• Screen-Read-Reason-Act Loop: Translates plain-English goals
into deterministic tap, type & swipe sequences
• LLM-Agnostic & Private: Supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini,
Groq or local Ollama with zero telemetry (`Apache-2.0`)
• Preflight Diagnostic: `appclaw doctor` verifies Node 22+ & ADB
✓ Replaces brittle coordinate-locked Appium test scripts
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R32-R591-MCPJAM-DEX-AIRCLAW-APPCLAW · 44 Engineers @ $100.00/h)
Path A: Cloud Eval SaaS + Manual dbt Sync + Mobile Cloud
• Cloud SaaS, OpenClaw API & Device Cloud: $3,260.00 / mo
• Manual MCP/dbt/Appium Maintenance: 40.5 h × $100 = $4,050.00 / mo
• Overhead: Untested 18-client MCP drift, obsolete Snowflake/
Databricks semantic views & runaway cloud OpenClaw bills
Path C: Hybrid OSS (MCPJam + Dex + AirClaw + AppClaw)
• Local Workstation & Emulator Compute: $75.00 / mo
• Eval & Semantic Layer Review: 2.4 h/mo × $100/h = $240.00 / mo
• Outcome: 18-client/170-model MCP CI, 6-target semantic sync,
$0 local `:4096` OpenClaw & zero-telemetry mobile QA
